label: Section front
description: A section index. Lock it to a tag and it becomes that section's page; leave the tag empty and it lists everything with a tag filter across the top.

page_options.label: Locked to tag
page_options.description: Type the tag the way you wrote it on the post — Business, The Economy, Asia Pacific. Capitals and spaces do not matter. Not sure what you have used? Open a Section front with no tag set: the filter chips across the top list every tag on the site. Leave empty to list every post and show the tag filter across the top.
